_README: USD per million tokens. Fill each entry from the OFFICIAL pricing page, set retrieved_at, then flip verified to true. cost() refuses to run on verified:false. Do not copy rates out of blog posts — that is exactly the second-hand-number problem this repo is about.
_CACHE_WRITE_TIERS: Anthropic bills two cache-write prices: 1.25x base input for the 5-minute TTL, 2x for the 1-hour one, and 0.1x for a read. Providers with automatic caching and no TTL concept set both write fields to the same number (0 where there is no write charge at all).
